sentences.text: Monica Sabastin vs Manoj Chaudhary on 7 August, 2025

Author: Pankaj Mithal
Bench: Pankaj Mithal
 Tp 
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Original Jurisdiction
 Transfer Petition (Criminal) No.315 Of 2025
 Monica Sabastin 
 Versus
 Manoj Chaudhary 
 O R D E R
1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The petitioner alleging herself to be the wife of the respondent has made a complaint, i.e. FIR No.74 of 2020 under Section 376 of the IPC registered at PS-Hariparwat, Agra, Uttar Pradesh against the respondent, upon which investigation has been completed and it is said, a closure statement has been submitted.
The closure report has not yet been accepted.

3. The petitioner at this juncture has filed this transfer petition seeking transfer of the aforesaid proceedings presently pending before Chief Judicial Magistrate, Agra, Uttar Pradesh to the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi.

entities.text: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Agra, Uttar Pradesh

entities.text: Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi

sentences.text: 4. In the facts and circumstances of the case, we do not consider it appropriate to transfer the case at this stage, until and unless, the Court where the matter is TP (CRIMINAL) NO.315 OF 2025 pending takes a final call upon the closure report.

Once a decision is taken on the said report, the petitioner,
if necessary, may seek transfer of the proceedings.
5. The Transfer Petition is disposed of with the above observation.
6. Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
